text:
elaine: Heads-up  goal tonight: finalize launch post ops (keywords, schema, internal-link map, redirects). Need sign-off by EOD Thu.
marco: will do keywords + anchor CSV. aiming for a concise list (20 KW targets). prioritize product benchmarks and integration how-tos.
jamal: adding 2 schema types: Event for webinar, Article for benchmark posts. quick Article example to paste into <head>:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Redwood Inference benchmark: latency & cost","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"datePublished":"2026-04-10"}
```
sophia: Redirect inventory in sheet (pre-2024 slugs). Proposed flow: 302 test for 7 days -> 301 canonicalize. sheet link shared in thread.
elaine: add column for anchor_rewrite mapping to ensure CTAs point to webinar signup and demo funnel. keep anchor language consistent.
marco: mapping idea: launch seed -> clusters (benchmark, integration, pricing, migration, case study). anchor examples: "launch benchmarks", "integrate with X", "cost/perf comparison". cap to 2 contextual links per cluster to avoid overlinking. I'll add CSV with columns: source_url,target_url,anchor_text,reason.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts/ has 6 images missing alt attributes, 3 orphaned internal links flagged (rows 12, 56, 78).
jamal: when adding JSON-LD validate with Rich Results Test and run simple Lighthouse check. I'll do one pass after we push.
sophia: sample nginx rewrites for infra (in sheet comments):
```
# temporary 302
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# promote to 301 after test window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: scheduling: infra window requested 02:00-04:00 UTC. Keep rollout small: benchmark pages first, then launch posts.
marco: ETA CSV 16:00 PST. will also clean alt tags and broken anchors.
jamal: I'll prep schema validation checklist: event fields, image object presence, article mainEntityOfPage.
elaine: final checklist by EOD Thu:
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV uploaded to shared drive
- jamal: schema snippets + validation notes
- sophia: redirect sheet + 302->301 plan + infra ticket
- elaine: copy QA + CTA placement (single primary CTA on top-of-funnel)
marco: ack :thumbsup:
sophia: ack, will ping infra once redirects reviewed
jamal: ack, will run smoke validation after JSON-LD is live
elaine: small follow-up: keep outreach messaging concise, one CTA target per top-funnel page (webinar signup). iterate based on post-launch metrics. :rocket:
